title: packet-frame: Fix NULL deref and stale matches in color filter display
description:
Two bugs in the multi-colour coloring block introduced by commit b77ce0d2:

1. NULL dereference: when every matching color rule is session-disabled
   ("paused"), color_filters_colorize_packet_all() returns NULL for the
   primary color_filter but still populates the matches list.  The
   has_color_info flag was then set to true even though color_filter was
   NULL, and with gui_packet_list_multi_color_details OFF the else
   fallback dereferences color_filter->filter_name -> SIGSEGV.

   Fixed by dropping has_color_info entirely and expressing each condition
   directly on color_filter, as suggested by @JaapKeuter.
   The two display paths (matches list and single-filter fallback) now
   each guard themselves.

2. Stale proto_data: when a rule change causes a packet to stop
   matching entirely, the need_colorize path only cleared old proto_data
   when new matches were found.  If matches is NULL the old list
   persisted, causing Frame Details to show the previous (now wrong)
   filter text until a manual reload.

   Fix by always clearing old proto_data on re-colorization, then
   conditionally storing new matches.

Verification:
1. Normal coloring: open a capture with active rules, open Frame Details
   -> confirm color filter name/text shown.
2. Pref OFF: disable gui_packet_list_multi_color_details, open Frame
   Details -> single filter shown.
3. All paused + pref OFF: session-disable all matching rules, open Frame
   Details -> no crash, no entries.
4. All paused + pref ON: session-disable all matching rules, pref ON
   -> [PAUSED] entries appear.
5. Reproduce the reported crash steps (modify Checksum errors rule back
   and forth) -> no crash.

AI-Assisted: yes
